status: pre-registered before full-MISATO sparse throughput benchmark
scope: first filtered official training complex only; no validation/test access

model.neighbour_rule: nearest protein C-alpha positions within the same complex; Euclidean distance invariant

benchmark.reason: isolate forward/backward graph cost without weight drift

gate.selection: choose smallest top_k passing every gate; otherwise retain dense and investigate radius graphs

decision_boundary: A pass authorizes a 32-train multi-complex sparse learnability gate only, not full training or validation/test access.
